subject: Intro: Brightleaf x Redwood (AWS co-sell) — mutual action plan & kickoff
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@amazon.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Jamie Torres <jamie@brightleaf.io>
Date: 2027-08-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: AWS intro — Brightleaf (potential marketplace + co-sell)

Hi Marissa,

Quick intro — I'm Priya (AWS WW ISV alliances). We recently ran a workshop with Brightleaf Analytics (cc'd) and they are evaluating a marketplace listing + AWS co-sell motion. They have an enterprise LLM inference use case (real-time analytics for advertising telemetry) and are targeting an initial procurement in Q4.

Brightleaf would benefit from joint GTM (listing + co-sell) and is asking for a short intro to Redwood to discuss:
- Marketplace listing process & timeline (AWS SaaS/AMIs)
- Technical fit for low-latency inference on customer data in our target regions
- Typical co-sell play (mutual action plan + exec alignment)

Can you take a quick look and intro the right folks? If useful, we can do a 30-min intro next week. Jamie — any calendar constraints?

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Shah
Sr. Partner Manager, AWS ISV
pri...@amazon.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@amazon.com>
Cc: Jamie Torres <jamie@brightleaf.io>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-21T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS intro — Brightleaf (potential marketplace + co-sell)

Hi Priya / Jamie — thanks for the intro. Happy to lead on the Redwood side. Looping in Karthik (sales lead for marketplace/co-sell) and Laura (solutions engineering) to map technical and commercial expectations.

I've attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) template to get us started — fills in typical milestones (listing, security vetting, proof-of-concept, procurement). Quick asks from our side to prepare for a productive kickoff:
- Jamie: can you share target regions and anticipated contract vehicle (SaaS subscription vs. marketplace listing)?
- Priya: any AWS field reps or merchant team contacts we should include for procurement sync?
- Team: please review the attached MAP and drop comments inline — I propose a 30-min joint intro to align on outcomes and timing.

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue Aug 24, 11:00–11:30
- Wed Aug 25, 14:00–14:30
- Thu Aug 26, 09:00–09:30

If none work, happy to coordinate via Doodle/Calendly. Attaching: Brightleaf-MAP-draft-v1.pdf for initial review.

—
Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachments: Brightleaf-MAP-draft-v1.pdf

From: Jamie Torres <jamie@brightleaf.io>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@amazon.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-22T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS intro — Brightleaf (potential marketplace + co-sell)

Thanks Marissa — great to meet you both. A few quick data points from our side to help frame the kickoff:
- Primary regions: us-east-1 (initial), then eu-west-1 in 2028.
- Procurement: likely enterprise SaaS contract, but we want the listing to live in AWS Marketplace for discoverability and expedited procurement during renewal.
- Goals for the first 90 days: 1) POC with 3 customer pilots; 2) Marketplace listing approved; 3) Sales enablement content for AWS field.

I've attached a simple architecture sketch that shows our inference flows and where Redwood would sit. A couple of asks up front:
1) Security/compliance checklist — we are SOC 2 in progress and need to confirm Redwood's logging/audit capabilities for our customers.
2) Sample pricing bands for dedicated vs hosted inference for enterprise (ballpark numbers are fine).

All three of the proposed times look okay — pref for Wed Aug 25 14:00–14:30 PST. Please send calendar invite and we will confirm attendees from our side.

Best,
Jamie Torres
Head of Product, Brightleaf Analytics
Attachments: Brightleaf-architecture-sketch.png

On Fri, Aug 21, 2027 at 10:03 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Priya / Jamie — thanks for the intro. Happy to lead on the Redwood side....

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jamie@brightleaf.io, priya.shah@amazon.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-24T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS intro — Brightleaf (potential marketplace + co-sell)

Thanks everyone — Wed Aug 25 at 14:00 PST booked (calendar invite attached). Quick alignment from Redwood for the meeting:
- Attendees: Marissa (partnerships), Karthik (sales lead), Laura (solutions engineer), and me for enablement notes.
- Meeting goals (30m):
  1) Confirm Brightleaf target outcomes + success metrics for co-sell.
  2) Walk through MAP milestones and owners (we'll capture dates in HubSpot).
  3) Identify any security gating items that block listing.

Immediate action items (pre-meeting):
- Marissa: I'll ask Sales Ops to pull and share our standard Marketplace checklist and pricing bands (expected by EOD Aug 24).
- Laura: please review the attached architecture sketch and highlight any compatibility gaps; if you need telemetry samples, ask Jamie to share.
- Jamie: if you have an initial list of pilot customers (3), please add them to the HubSpot deal or share offline.

I've attached the calendar invite as calendar-invite.ics and linked the HubSpot deal here: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deal/BRI-2027-0456. Looking forward to the sync.

—
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
